verdict.rationale: Twenty's docs say you can connect a Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 mailbox. Emails are then automatically linked to the matching Company and People records, with import filters by date range or sender. Nothing documents two-way sync, such as sending or replying from the CRM and having it reflect back in the mailbox; the workflow 'Send email' action is a separate feature. Missing for 10: documented two-way (bidirectional) email sync, independent or hands-on corroboration of matching accuracy, and detail on how records are matched and how often sync runs.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records

citations.quote: Connect your Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 account.
Emails are automatically linked to the matching Company and People records
You control what gets imported — filter by date range or sender to avoid pulling in irrelevant emails.
